toegepas.rede_vinder: Two separable compound verbs sharing a past participle are written oop- en toegetrek, with a hyphen.
toegepas.fout: Separable compound verbs sharing a participle are written apart and without the hyphen ('oop en toe getrek').
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'oop- en toegetrek' is the correct spelling and the meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.rede_vinder: After 'Sipho' and 'hom', the second 'hy' could mean either boy, so naming Karabo removes the doubt (same word count); the comma is needed because both clauses have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: The second 'hy' could refer to Sipho or Karabo, since both were just named.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming Karabo, already in the paragraph, removes the ambiguity, keeps the next 'Hy' pointing at Karabo, and the comma is correct because both clauses have their own subject and verb.

toegepas.voor: Van die ander kinders het gedink
toegepas.na: Party van die ander kinders het gedink
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Van die' for 'some of the' is colloquial and can read as a broken sentence to a Grade 4 reader; 'Party van die' is standard and keeps the meaning.
toegepas.fout: Partitive 'Van die' opening a sentence can read as a broken prepositional phrase to a Grade 4 reader.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Party van die' is plainer standard Afrikaans and keeps the same 'some of' qualifier.

toegepas.voor: Die skoot het geklap en die kinders
toegepas.na: Die skoot het geklap, en die kinders
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS 2017 comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Die skoot het geklap' and 'die kinders het weggeskiet' are full clauses, so the comma is required.

toegepas.voor: saam met hom gekom al hardloop
toegepas.na: saam met hom gekom, al hardloop
toegepas.rede_vinder: A comma before the concessive clause starting with 'al' makes the sentence easier to read.
toegepas.fout: 'gekom al hardloop' runs the main clause straight into the concessive clause, which makes a young reader stumble.
toegepas.rede_keurder: A comma before the 'al' clause marks the clause boundary and changes nothing in the meaning.
